title: Public Service Amendment (Employment for all of us) Bill 2014
short_title: Public Service Amendment (Employment for all of us) Bill 2014

summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: The bill would require employment targets in the Australian Public Service for people with disability and employees who come from a non-English speaking background.
The Commissioner would have to direct that the total number in each group double by 1 July 2019, using 1 July 2014 as the baseline.
The requirements would be inserted into the Public Service Act 1999 and would start on the day after the bill received Royal Assent.
changes: Disability would take its meaning from the Disability Discrimination Act 1992.
A new subsection would require a written employment direction covering both groups.
The Commissioner's general employment direction powers would be subject to the new requirement.
summary.affected: The Commissioner and Australian Public Service employees with disability or from non-English speaking backgrounds are affected.
